title: The Best Box Chocolate Cake
description: A simple hack to elevate a standard box cake mix into a homemade-tasting dessert.
steps: In a large bowl, combine the yellow cake mix, eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla extract.
Mix the ingredients together until well combined.
Pour the batter into an 8 by 11 inch baking pan.
Bake for approximately 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let the cake cool completely.
Place the chocolate icing in the microwave for about 15 seconds to make it pourable.
Stir the icing and pour it evenly over the top of the cooled cake.
Use a knife to spread the icing into the corners and let it set before serving.
notes:
Using melted butter instead of oil and milk instead of water adds a richer, more homemade flavor and texture to the cake.
